title: See the remaining popup headers and scroll edges

steps.path: Marketplace → a plugin → open a skill file
steps.hint: Scroll inside each file; scroll outside to switch versions. Compare the plugin label in Meadow Mist and Halftone Dimension.
steps.headline: Which file header and scrolling edge feels right?
steps.risk: Sample file only; the one-line option hides plugin/type context. No production styling changed.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: Plugin/type above 18px semibold file name; full-width line, no fade.

variants.label: Keep both lines
variants.summary: Two lines, medium file name, 8% divider, 42px/4%-side fade.

variants.label: One compact line
variants.summary: File name only at 16px medium, with the same divider and fade.

steps.hint: Open each version in a New Window to see the full editor; shrink that window until the body scrolls to compare its edge.
steps.headline: How much of this treatment belongs on the smaller Tags popup?
steps.risk: The fade stays off if the editor fits; Manage Tags is already covered by the shared Dialog. No production styling changed.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: 14px bold title, full-width divider, bare body.

variants.label: Divider only
variants.summary: 16px medium title and 8% divider, no content fade.

variants.label: Divider and fade
variants.summary: 16px medium title, 8% divider, 42px content fade with 4% sides only while scrolling.
